main.name: main
main.purpose: Bootstrap the Flutter application and set up providers
main.concern: Application initialization and dependency injection setup

flow.out: Fully initialized app with dependency injection

talks_to.app_host: provides root widget for UI rendering
talks_to.flutter_riverpod: establishes global provider scope for state management

main.flowNotes: Entry point that bootstraps the Flutter app with Riverpod state management and launches the main UI widget

app_host.name: AppHost
app_host.purpose: Central UI orchestrator managing app phases and map lifecycle
app_host.concern: UI state coordination and map management lifecycle

flow.in: App state from appLogicProvider, map events
flow.does: watch state → render phase overlay → manage map transitions → handle errors
flow.out: Rendered UI with appropriate overlay for current phase

talks_to.app_logic_provider: consumes app state and calls state actions
talks_to.phase_overlays: renders UI for specific app phases

app_logic_provider.name: AppLogicNotifier
app_logic_provider.purpose: Core business logic, state management, and journey state machine
app_logic_provider.concern: Centralized state management and automatic journey progression

flow.in: User actions, service responses, location updates, arrival events
flow.does: validate → call services → run state machine → manage timers → coordinate automatic navigation → handle transitions
flow.out: Updated AppUiState, automatic step transitions, timer management

talks_to.montevideo_api_service: fetches bus data and ETAs with conditional polling
talks_to.geocoding_service: handles location search and reverse geocoding
talks_to.location_tracker: manages automatic navigation and arrival detection
talks_to.hybrid_bus_tracker: switches between API and user location modes

behavior: finite state machine for journey steps
conditional ETA polling (stops when user boards bus)
bus boarding detection via speed + location analysis
sideEffects: stops ETA polling when user transitions to RIDING_BUS
switches bus tracking from API to user location mode
app_logic_provider.flowNotes: Implements complete journey state machine with automatic transitions: WALKING_TO_STOP → WAITING_FOR_BUS → RIDING_BUS → WALKING_TO_DESTINATION

journey_state_machine.name: Journey State Machine
journey_state_machine.purpose: Automatic journey step transitions and state management
journey_state_machine.concern: Finite state machine for journey progression

flow.in: arrival events, current step state, location updates
flow.out: automatic step transitions and tracking mode changes

behavior: configures appropriate tracking for each step
journey_state_machine.flowNotes: Core state machine implementing the exact transitions: Arrive at stop → Wait for bus → Board bus → On the bus → Arrive at destination stop → Next step

bus_boarding_detector.name: Bus Boarding Detector
bus_boarding_detector.purpose: Detects when user boards bus using location and speed analysis
bus_boarding_detector.concern: Movement pattern analysis for bus boarding detection

flow.in: user location, user speed, bus route geometry

outputs.name: boardingDetected
outputs.description: Whether user has boarded the bus

sideEffects: triggers transition from WAITING_FOR_BUS to RIDING_BUS
bus_boarding_detector.flowNotes: Implements sophisticated bus boarding detection using combined location proximity and speed analysis to distinguish between 'waiting at stop' vs 'riding bus'

hybrid_bus_tracker.name: Hybrid Bus Tracker
hybrid_bus_tracker.purpose: Switches bus tracking data source based on user state
hybrid_bus_tracker.concern: Conditional ETA polling and tracking mode management

flow.in: journey step type, user location, bus position
flow.out: appropriate tracking configuration and ETA polling control

behavior: WALKING/WAITING: API tracking + ETA polling active
RIDING_BUS: user location mode + ETA polling STOPPED
automatic mode switching on step transitions
sideEffects: prevents unnecessary API calls during bus riding
hybrid_bus_tracker.flowNotes: Implements the exact flow requirement: 'Stop ETA polling' when user transitions to riding bus, and 'User = bus location' mode switching

location_tracker.name: LocationTracker
location_tracker.purpose: GPS tracking with geofence-based arrival detection
location_tracker.concern: Real-time location tracking and automatic arrival detection

flow.in: GPS permissions, destination coordinates, geofence configurations

talks_to.geolocator: GPS location services with speed data

behavior: speed data collection for boarding detection
location_tracker.flowNotes: Provides the foundation for automatic journey transitions by detecting when user arrives at destinations and providing speed data for bus boarding detection

map_manager.name: MapManager
map_manager.purpose: Unified map state management with dynamic zoom and hybrid tracking
map_manager.concern: Map visualization lifecycle, dynamic zoom, and tracking mode coordination

flow.in: Route data, bus positions, phase changes, tracking mode switches
flow.does: initialize → render routes → manage dynamic zoom → coordinate hybrid tracking → optimize transitions
flow.out: Updated map visualization with intelligent camera control and hybrid data sources

talks_to.map_bus_realtime: displays real-time bus positions with mode switching
talks_to.map_camera_controller: handles dynamic zoom for multiple points

map_camera_controller.name: MapCameraController
map_camera_controller.purpose: Dynamic zoom control for multiple points of interest
map_camera_controller.concern: Camera control and zoom optimization for bus + stop visualization

flow.in: multiple coordinates (bus + stop), current leg info
flow.out: optimal viewport showing all points of interest

behavior: dynamic padding based on UI elements
includes real-time bus positions in zoom

inputs.name: coordinates
inputs.description: Points to include in viewport (stop + bus)

sideEffects: animates map camera to optimal zoom level
map_camera_controller.flowNotes: Implements the exact requirement 'dynamic stop-bus zoom' by calculating optimal viewport to show both bus stop and approaching bus simultaneously

map_bus_realtime.name: MapBusRealtime
map_bus_realtime.purpose: Hybrid bus tracking with automatic mode switching
map_bus_realtime.concern: Real-time bus visualization with context-aware data sources

flow.in: bus positions, user location, tracking mode commands
flow.out: real-time bus visualization with appropriate data source

behavior: USER_LOCATION mode for riding bus phase
automatic mode switching on step transitions
sideEffects: switches between API polling and user GPS
map_bus_realtime.flowNotes: Implements hybrid tracking where bus position comes from API when waiting, but switches to user location when riding, fulfilling 'User = bus location' requirement

phase_overlays.name: Phase Overlays
phase_overlays.purpose: Phase-specific UI with automatic navigation integration
phase_overlays.concern: Context-sensitive user interface with journey progress visualization

active_trip_overlay.name: ActiveTripOverlay
active_trip_overlay.purpose: Journey guidance with automatic and manual navigation modes
active_trip_overlay.concern: Step-by-step guidance with automatic transition detection

flow.in: journey steps, automatic transitions, location updates, bus tracking data
flow.out: responsive guidance interface with automatic step progression

behavior: automatic transition detection and UI adaptation
dual mode: automatic vs manual navigation
conditional UI elements based on navigation mode

outputs.name: adaptiveUI
outputs.description: UI adapted to current navigation mode

sideEffects: adapts UI controls based on automatic navigation state
active_trip_overlay.flowNotes: Provides comprehensive journey guidance that automatically adapts UI when system detects step transitions, hiding manual controls during automatic navigation
